name: Lyo.Geolocation
tagline: Geospatial operations and persistence contracts that do not pick a vendor.
description:
Geospatial operations and persistence contracts that do not pick a vendor.

**Archetype A (Lyo domain).** Vendor Maps clients (e.g. [`Lyo.Google.Geolocation.Client`](../../../Integration/Google/Lyo.Google.Geolocation.Client/README.md)) are Archetype C under `Integration/{Vendor}/`. See [package layout](../../../docs/package-layout.md).

examples.title: How a consumer composes this

sections.title: Assemblies
sections.trail: HTTP clients and vendor SDKs are not referenced here. Wire providers and import mappers in the host (API, worker, tool).

sections.title: `IGeolocationService`
sections.text: The contract for routing, geocoding, distance, and time zone work (implementations live in separate integration packages).

sections.title: `IGeolocationStore`
items: `geolocation.address_source`. Import provenance: `source_entity_*` + `imported_at` (owner `address_id` on parent). The importing app supplies external type strings, for example `GoogleMapsPlace`.

sections.title: How a consumer composes this
sections.text: The API or worker registers provider(s) and the store, and maps vendor DTOs onto `Address` + `Sources`. Vendor-specific `EntityRef` type names (for example `GoogleMapsPlace`) belong in the integration package that does the mapping, not this assembly.

sections.title: Related reading
sections.text: Internal people rows with their own `*_source` tables: [`Lyo.People.Models`](../People/Lyo.People.Models/README.md). At import time, link across stores with `EntityRef`.
